item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register the administrator and a user, issue API keys for both, list, revoke and re-check a second key.

request.description:
step: auth.key
label: Issue API key
kind: required

Logs in as the default administrator by issuing an API key; a 401 means that account does not exist yet and the next steps register it.

step: auth.admin
label: Register administrator
kind: optional
when: adminExists=no

Registers the default administrator when the login above failed; on an empty database the first registered account becomes the administrator.

step: auth.adminkey
label: Issue admin key
kind: optional
when: adminExists=no

Issues the administrator's API key after the registration above.

step: auth.user
label: Register user
kind: optional

Registers a new ordinary user under a unique e-mail for this run and captures that e-mail for the following steps.

step: auth.userkey
label: Issue user API key
kind: optional

Issues an API key for the ordinary user, showing that each account owns its own keys.

step: auth.second
label: Issue second API key
kind: optional

Issues a second key for the administrator so that it can be listed, revoked and then rejected.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("secondKeyId", Math.max.apply(null, pm.response.json().filter(function (k) { return k.label === pm.collectionVariables.get("secondKeyLabel"); }).map(function (k) { return k.id; })));

request.description:
step: auth.keys
label: List API keys
kind: optional

Lists the administrator's keys and stores the id of the second key for the revoke step.

step: auth.revoke
label: Revoke second API key
kind: optional

Revokes the second key using the administrator's key; it must answer 204.

exec: pm.test("revoked key is rejected", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description:
step: auth.revoked
label: Revoked key is rejected
kind: optional

Sends the revoked second key to a protected endpoint, which must now be rejected with 401.

step: auth.again
label: Revoke again
kind: optional

Revokes the already revoked second key again, which must answer 409.

item.name: Taxons
item.description: Creates a category and a city with unique names, reads, updates, reverts through the history, deletes and restores the category, then deletes what it created.

request.description:
step: taxons.category
label: Create category
kind: required

Creates the flow category with English and Ukrainian translations and stores its id and version.

step: taxons.city
label: Create city
kind: optional

Creates the flow city with English and Ukrainian translations and stores its id and version.

step: taxons.list
label: List taxons
kind: optional

Lists the taxons visible to the administrator.

step: taxons.get
label: Get category
kind: optional

Reads the flow category and refreshes its version for the following writes.

step: taxons.update
label: Update category
kind: optional

Renames the flow category in both languages and refreshes its version.

step: taxons.history
label: Category history
kind: optional

Lists the history snapshots of the flow category and remembers the first snapshot id.

step: taxons.snapshot
label: Read first state
kind: optional

Reads the first recorded state of the flow category.

step: taxons.revert
label: Restore first state
kind: optional

Reverts the flow category to its first recorded state and refreshes its version.

step: taxons.delete
label: Delete category
kind: optional

Soft-deletes the flow category.

step: taxons.restore
label: Restore category
kind: optional

Restores the soft-deleted flow category and refreshes its version.

step: taxons.cleanup
label: Delete category again
kind: optional

Deletes the flow category again so the run leaves no active category behind.

step: taxons.cleancity
label: Delete city
kind: optional

Deletes the flow city created by this run.

item.name: Infrastructure
item.description: Public liveness and sitemap endpoints, no authentication.

request.description:
step: infra.health
label: Health
kind: required

Checks that the application is alive.

step: infra.sitemap
label: Sitemap
kind: optional

Fetches the public sitemap.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Creates its own category and city, then creates, lists, reads, updates, reverts through the history and deletes a provider profile of the flow user, confirms it is gone and deletes the category and city.

request.description:
step: profile.category
label: Create category
kind: optional

Creates the flow profile category with English and Ukrainian translations and stores its id and version.

step: profile.city
label: Create city
kind: optional

Creates the flow profile city with English and Ukrainian translations and stores its id and version.

step: profile.create
label: Create profile
kind: required

Creates a provider profile for the flow user in the flow category and city and stores its id and version.

step: profile.list
label: List profiles
kind: optional

Lists the provider profiles visible without authentication.

step: profile.get
label: Get profile
kind: optional

Reads the flow user's provider profile and stores its current version.

step: profile.update
label: Update profile
kind: optional

Updates the flow user's provider profile about text and stores its new version.

step: profile.history
label: Profile history
kind: optional

Lists the change history of the profile and stores the id of the earliest snapshot.

step: profile.snapshot
label: Read first state
kind: optional

Reads the earliest snapshot of the profile from its history.

step: profile.revert
label: Restore first state
kind: optional

Restores the profile to the earliest snapshot and stores its new version.

step: profile.delete
label: Delete profile
kind: optional

Deletes the flow user's provider profile.

step: profile.gone
label: Deleted profile is gone
kind: optional

Confirms that the deleted provider profile can no longer be read.

step: profile.cleancat
label: Delete category
kind: optional

Deletes the flow profile category created for this folder.

step: profile.cleancity
label: Delete city
kind: optional

Deletes the flow profile city created for this folder.

item.name: Advertisements
item.description: Creates its own category and city, then creates, lists, reads, updates, reverts through the history and deletes an advertisement of the flow user, confirms it is gone and deletes the category and city.

request.description:
step: ads.category
label: Create category
kind: optional

Creates the flow advertisement category with English and Ukrainian translations and stores its id and version.

step: ads.city
label: Create city
kind: optional

Creates the flow advertisement city with English and Ukrainian translations and stores its id and version.

step: ads.create
label: Create advertisement
kind: required

Creates an advertisement of the flow user in the flow category and city and stores its id and version.

step: ads.list
label: List advertisements
kind: optional

Lists the advertisements visible without authentication.

step: ads.get
label: Get advertisement
kind: optional

Reads the flow user's advertisement and stores its current version.

step: ads.update
label: Update advertisement
kind: optional

Updates the title of the flow user's advertisement using the stored version and stores the new version.

step: ads.history
label: Advertisement history
kind: optional

Lists the saved states of the flow user's advertisement and stores the id of the earliest one.

step: ads.snapshot
label: Read first state
kind: optional

Reads the earliest saved state of the flow user's advertisement.

step: ads.revert
label: Restore first state
kind: optional

Restores the flow user's advertisement to its earliest saved state and stores the new version.

step: ads.delete
label: Delete advertisement
kind: optional

Deletes the flow user's advertisement using the stored version.

step: ads.gone
label: Deleted ad is gone
kind: optional

Confirms that the deleted advertisement can no longer be read.

step: ads.cleancat
label: Delete category
kind: optional

Deletes the flow advertisement category created for this folder.

step: ads.cleancity
label: Delete city
kind: optional

Deletes the flow advertisement city created for this folder.
